note: Marauder was a model/sub-model only in 1963 (mid-year, '1963 1/2') through 1965, 1969-1970 and 2003-2004. No Marauder model in 1966-1968 (Hagerty: the Marauder sub-model disappeared for '66; the name lived on only as engine names, e.g. Marauder 410 / Super Marauder 428) or 1971-2002 (the 2002 Chicago show car was a concept; production cars were 2003 models built from May 2002). 1963-65 Marauders were fastback-roof hardtops within Monterey Custom / S-55 (1963) and Monterey / Montclair / Park Lane (1964-65). All Lincoln-Mercury brochures count as one source. Gross hp through 1970; SAE net 2003-04. Engine codes are given as the factory engine names; VIN letter codes were not confirmed by a reputable source (except FordMuscle's B/G codes for the disputed 406s).
